meta.name: google-agents-cli-eval
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "run an evaluation", "evaluate my agent", "evaluate my ADK agent", "write an eval dataset", "analyze eval failures", "compare eval results", "optimize agent", or needs guidance on the Agent Platform eval methodology and the Quality Flywheel. Covers eval metrics, dataset schema, LLM-as-judge scoring, and common failure causes. Applies to any agents-cli project, whatever framework the agent is written in. Do NOT use for agent API code patterns (ADK: use google-agents-cli-adk-code), deployment (use google-agents-cli-deploy), or project scaffolding (use google-agents-cli-scaffold).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把智能体的回答跑成分数,找出答错的原因并改进它
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在做智能体,想量化它的表现并定位出错的环节
copy.tagline_en: Score your agent's answers and find out why they fail
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an agent and need to measure and improve its quality

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在你的 agents-cli 项目里帮你跑智能体评估：按数据集生成运行轨迹、用指标打分，产出带时间戳的 JSON 和网页结果文件，对比前后两次结果，并针对失败的指标给出具体改法。
howto.when: 当你说要「跑评估」「写评估数据集」「对比评估结果」等，或想按 Quality Flywheel 迭代优化智能体时，它就会接管。

say.text: 帮我用 agents-cli eval run 跑一遍评估
对比一下修复前后的评估结果
say.note: 用 eval compare 看目标指标是否变好

say.text: 我的多轮任务成功率低，该改什么？
say.note: 按失败指标给出对应的修改方向

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs evals in your agents-cli project: it generates traces from a dataset, scores them with metrics, writes timestamped JSON/HTML reports, compares runs, and maps failed metrics to fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to run an evaluation, write an eval dataset, compare eval results, or optimize an agent with the Quality Flywheel.

say_en.text: Run agents-cli eval run on my agent
say_en.note: Generates traces, grades them, writes results.

say_en.text: Compare the eval results before and after my fix
say_en.note: Uses eval compare to check the target metric.

say_en.text: My multi-turn task success is low — what should I change?
say_en.note: Maps failed metrics to suggested fixes.
